notes: EU Commission update: Euronews reports the attack is ongoing, that the Commission confirmed EU Academy names and email addresses leaked, and, citing two anonymous sources, that a China-backed network is suspected. Actor left empty because no government or investigating firm attribution was read. The EU Academy offline date differs: Euronews says Saturday 21 November, Gazeta.ru citing Reuters says 23 November; both recorded in impact. The first build failed on another worker's file (cleverbridge-payment-card-data-breach-2026-11, figure-no-evidence), which this researcher did not touch; it passed on rerun. My own event validates with only the existing source-published-partial warning on older sources.
